stories.title: Goodwill's annual Thanksgiving dinner connects Baltimore residents with community resources
stories.summary: Goodwill's 69th annual Thanksgiving dinner and resource fair in Baltimore served as a place for the community to come together and get any help that they may need.

stories.title: Army detonates unstable lead explosives at Iowa munitions plant despite community concerns
stories.summary: The U.S. Army detonated a stockpile of degrading explosives at a munitions plant in Iowa on Wednesday, after days of back-and-forth between politicians and the courts.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed until Saturday due to weather for first time in its 100-year history
stories.summary: For the first time in history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed due to weather, Macy's said Wednesday.

stories.title: Thanksgiving nor'easter to bring rain, wind and high tides for Maryland
stories.summary: CBS News Baltimore's Cutter Martin has the latest weather forecast.

stories.title: Baltimore wins preliminary injunction against "Waz Brothers"
stories.summary: The city alleges the landlords operate unlicensed apartment buildings that are unsafe and unsanitary.

stories.title: Man found guilty in quadruple shooting in Baltimore, faces 5 life sentences, plus 167 years
stories.summary: A man has been found guilty on all counts in a 2025 mass shooting in North Baltimore that left four people injured, the State's Attorney's Office announced Wednesday.

stories.title: Baltimore Police: Suspect wanted in nonprofit burglary

stories.title: Maryland's Festival of Trees benefits Kennedy Krieger and students like 3rd grader Chozin
stories.summary: The Festival of Trees returns this weekend at the Maryland State Fairgrounds, and the proceeds benefit Kennedy Krieger programs and kids like 3rd grader Chozin Best, who went from a patient to a student.

stories.title: Thanksgiving nor'easter brings Maryland damaging winds, heavy rain and high tides
stories.summary: The WJZ First Alert Weather Team has made Thanksgiving Day a First Alert Weather Day, as a strong nor'easter brings heavy rain, damaging winds, and high tides to Maryland.

stories.title: Marylanders brace for peak Thanksgiving travel at BWI and on the roads
stories.summary: AAA predicts 81.5 million people will travel at least 50 miles for Thanksgiving, and nearly 1.5 million Marylanders will travel over the holiday period.
